channel.title: Outreach on Best of AI
channel.description: Recent content in Outreach on Best of AI

item.title: Cognism
item.description:
Cognism helps salespeople reach the right people. Its database covers companies and contacts across regions, with a reputation for strong coverage in Europe and for verified mobile numbers, which are valuable for cold calling. Users filter by role, industry, size, and technology, then export or sync contacts to their CRM.

Intent data adds timing. Signals show which accounts are researching topics related to a product, so teams can prioritize outreach. Compliance is a selling point: the company screens contacts against do-not-call lists and says it follows privacy rules like GDPR, which matters for outreach in Europe.

item.title: Kaspr
item.description:
Kaspr is a contact data tool for outbound sales. While browsing a LinkedIn profile, a user clicks the Kaspr extension to reveal a professional email address and phone number, then saves the contact to a CRM or a list. It also supports bulk searches and enrichment of existing records.

The company emphasizes European data and compliance with privacy rules like GDPR, and offers ways for individuals to opt out of the database. Credits limit how many contact details a user can reveal each month, and integrations connect with CRMs and sales engagement tools.

item.title: Lusha
item.description:
Lusha helps sales and recruiting teams get in touch with prospects. While viewing a profile on LinkedIn or a company website, a user clicks the Lusha extension to reveal contact information, then saves it to a CRM. A database search finds contacts by role, company size, and industry.

Additional features include intent signals, technology data, and enrichment of existing lists, as well as integrations with Salesforce, HubSpot, and sales engagement tools. The company emphasizes compliance with privacy laws and offers ways for people to opt out.

item.title: Seamless AI
item.description:
Seamless.AI helps salespeople find who to contact. Users search by title, industry, and location, or use a browser extension to look up contacts on websites, and the platform returns emails and phone numbers pulled from public sources and its database. Lists export to CRMs and engagement tools.

Real-time search and enrichment aim to keep data fresh, and intent signals show which accounts may be in a buying cycle. AI features help write outreach and prioritize accounts.

item.title: Catchlight
item.description:
Catchlight is a lead scoring tool for financial advisory firms. It enriches a prospect’s profile with data such as estimated income, investable assets, age range, and interests, then applies a model trained on past conversions to produce a score showing how likely they are to become a client.

Advisors use it to prioritize their time. Instead of calling every inquiry, they can focus on those with the best fit, and see context to start a conversation. It integrates with CRMs used by advisors, such as Wealthbox, and appears in platforms that serve wealth management firms.

item.title: Apollo
item.description:
Apollo gives sales teams a place to find and contact prospects. Users search a database of people and companies by title, industry, size, and technology used, then add leads to email sequences, calling lists, and LinkedIn tasks. A browser extension finds contact details as you browse the web.

The platform includes tools for the whole outbound workflow: email verification, scheduling, a dialer, meeting booking, analytics, and integrations with CRMs like Salesforce and HubSpot. AI features help write messages, score leads, and automate steps, and workflows can enrich existing records to keep a CRM current.

item.title: Conversica
item.description:
Conversica automates the follow-up that sales teams often drop. When a lead comes in, the AI assistant sends personalized messages, reads replies, answers questions, and tries to book a meeting. If a prospect does not respond, it continues with a sequence of nudges, which keeps leads from going cold.

The assistants are used in industries such as automotive, education, software, and financial services, where large volumes of inquiries arrive. Conversation data flows into the CRM, so salespeople see which leads are qualified and what was said. The company has added generative AI to make conversations more natural.

item.title: Hunter
item.description: Hunter is a tool for finding contact details for business outreach. A Domain Search shows the email addresses associated with a company along with the sources where they were found, and the email pattern the company uses. An Email Finder takes a person’s name and company and returns the most likely address with a confidence score. Email Verifier checks whether an address is valid and likely to deliver, which reduces bounces.

item.title: LinkedIn Sales Navigator
item.description:
Sales Navigator gives salespeople deeper access to LinkedIn’s network. It provides advanced filters for finding people and companies, such as by seniority, function, company size, industry, and recent job changes. Users save leads and accounts into lists, and the system sends alerts when something relevant happens, like a prospect changing jobs or a company hiring in a certain department, which can prompt a timely message.

Further features support outreach. InMail messages reach people outside your network, TeamLink shows how colleagues are connected to a prospect for warm introductions, and integrations sync with CRMs such as Salesforce and HubSpot to keep records current. AI tools recommend leads, summarize accounts, and suggest ways to start a conversation, using the profile and activity data on the platform.

item.title: ZoomInfo
item.description:
ZoomInfo provides one of the largest databases of business contacts and companies. Sales and marketing teams search by title, industry, company size, location, and technology to build lists, and see verified email addresses, direct phone numbers, org charts, and firmographic details. Intent data shows which companies are researching topics related to a product, helping teams reach out when interest is high.

The platform has expanded from data into a workflow product. It includes tools for sales engagement, marketing advertising, conversation intelligence through Chorus, and enrichment that keeps CRM records up to date automatically. AI features include assistants that research accounts, draft outreach, and recommend who to contact, and agents that handle prospecting tasks. It integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, and other systems.
